Lemma
[The adapted chart at a regular point]

↗ lem:straighten-scalar-affine

Let $M$ be a smooth manifold without boundary, $f \in C^\infty (M)$, and $y \in M$ with $df_y eq 0$. Let $\kappa $ be a chart of $M$ at $y$. Then there is a diffeomorphism $G$ between open subsets of the model space, with $\kappa (y) \in \operatorname {dom} G \subseteq \operatorname {im} \kappa $ and $G(\kappa (y)) = \kappa (y)$, such that \[ f igl(\kappa ^{-1}(G^{-1}(v)) igr) = f(y) + df_y(v - \kappa (y)) \] for every $v$ in the image of $G$. Thus in the corrected chart $G \circ \kappa $ the function $f$ is affine, and the level set $f^{-1}(f(y))$ is the affine hyperplane slice $\{ v : df_y(v - \kappa (y)) = 0\} $.

Proof

↗ lem:straighten-scalar-affine The coordinate representative $f \circ \kappa ^{-1}$ is smooth on the open set $\operatorname {im} \kappa $, and because $M$ has no boundary its derivative at $\kappa (y)$ is exactly $df_y$. Apply Lemma 12 with $s = \operatorname {im}\kappa $, $u_0 = \kappa (y)$ and $\ell = df_y eq 0$, and rewrite $f(\kappa ^{-1}(G^{-1}(v)))$ using $\kappa ^{-1} \circ \kappa = \operatorname {id}$ on the chart domain.

□
